title: Peg's Famous Christmas Potatoes
creator: Corre Larkin (Cocolarkincooks)
cookTime: About 1 hour (30 min covered at 365°F, then 30 min uncovered at 350°F)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons finely chopped chives (optional, for garnish)
instructions: Step 1: Divide all ingredients into thirds (a cast iron pan takes 3 layers). Preheat the oven to 365°F.
Step 2: Melt the butter in the half and half just until melted; don't let it boil. Oil a cast iron pan or roasting tray with the avocado oil.
Step 3: Add a layer of shredded potatoes, a pinch of salt and pepper, a layer of chopped herbs, a thin layer of mozzarella and cheddar, and a dusting of Parmigiano.
Step 4: Repeat the layers until the potatoes and cheese are used, ending with mozzarella and cheddar.
Step 5: Pour the butter and half and half mixture evenly over the pan, then top with a thin layer of Parmigiano.
Step 6: Cover loosely with foil (not touching the cheese) and bake at 365°F for 30 minutes.
Step 7: Uncover and bake at 350°F for 30 more minutes, until the top is dark golden with a cheese crust.
Step 8: Rest a minute, sprinkle with chives if you like, and serve.
notes: From a Cocolarkincooks Facebook video (Corre Larkin). The caption is truncated, so the full recipe comes from her Substack post (Sep 26, 2026). Peg's original has no fresh herbs; Corre added them. If you shred fresh potatoes, squeeze them dry.
